variants.headline: Every machine you own is a recruit.
variants.note: Concept 1, Muster: roll call makes any number of machines tangible. Default and fallback.
variants.subhead: Install Blowhorn on one machine or fifty. Each one enlists, reports for duty and takes orders from you or your AI agent.

variants.headline: Your squad, on one map.
variants.note: Concept 2, Battalion Map: the fleet as units around HQ, a teammate's machine included, with a live reports feed.
variants.subhead: Install Blowhorn on every machine you have. Each one shows up as a unit, reports in and takes the next order.

variants.headline: Many voices. One thunder.
variants.note: Concept 3, One Thunder: people and machines wired into the Major's single call out to every platform.
variants.subhead: Your teammates, your machines, the brother in arms at the next desk. Major gathers every voice into one call, right on time.

variants.headline: From one recruit to a full squad.
variants.note: Concept 4, Call to Arms: the four-beat storyboard, Enlist, Muster, Rally, Thunder. The beats light up in sequence on the page.
variants.subhead: Install Blowhorn on one machine, then the next. Bring your team and your agents. Then Major sounds the call.
